Gordon Ryan Pillars Of Defense - Guillot.overview: Gordon Ryan's guillotine defence course in eight parts, organised by the position you're in when the guillotine comes. Part 1 covers the principles (chin to chest and others). Part 2 covers defending from top open guard (centring the head). Part 3 covers top half guard (clearing the legs). Part 4 covers bottom open guard. Part 5 covers bottom side control (the lower leg shift). Part 6 covers escaping from the front headlock (defensive hands). Parts 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan Pillars Of Defense - Guillot.for: No-gi grapplers who get caught in guillotines, especially while passing.
key: Defending while passing open and half guard

Gordon Ryan Systematically Dismantling O.overview: Gordon Ryan on shutting down positions he considers 'low percentage' but popular, eight parts. Part 1 is his philosophy ('listen to the best, dismiss the rest'). Part 2 covers countering the overback / octopus from half guard (beating the inside wrist grip). Part 3 covers countering bridges with a back take and moving to mount. Part 4 covers butterfly half guard (controlling the space between the knees). Part 5 covers the overback from side control. Part 6 covers countering the buggy choke. Part 7 (bonus) covers darce escapes and countering the darce peek-out. Part 8 is rolling.
Gordon Ryan Systematically Dismantling O.for: Top players who get frustrated by octopus guard, buggy chokes and similar 'trick' positions.
